visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is captured in a medium profile shot, standing against a metal railing overlooking a wide river. She is silhouetted by the brilliant golden sun reflecting intensely off the water's surface, creating a sparkling bokeh effect. She holds a smartphone in her hands, looking down at the screen. She is wearing a light-colored dress and a black shoulder bag, with a wide-brimmed straw hat hanging from her back. (2) The scene shifts to a wide shot of the waterfront. A silhouette of a person is seen walking on a pier near several large blue containers. The low sun continues to shimmer across the ripples of the water. In the far background, a dense urban skyline with high-rise buildings and industrial structures is visible under a hazy, late-afternoon sky. (3) The camera returns to the woman in a medium shot. She continues to scroll through her phone before briefly turning her head to look out at the scenic river view. Her long dark hair is loose, and the warm backlighting highlights her silhouette. The surrounding environment remains serene and bathed in golden light. (4) In a fuller shot, the woman smiles brightly and raises her phone, presumably to take a selfie or record the sunset. She appears relaxed and joyful, enjoying the peaceful atmosphere of the riverside promenade. The camera remains mostly static, focusing on her interactions with the environment and her device.
